name: megascenes-landscape-design
description: Redesign a garden, backyard, patio or terrace in the style you want, from a photo in your MegaScenes library or from a description.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a photo of your garden, yard or terrace from your MegaScenes library, or just describe it, and choose a style: modern, Mediterranean, cottage garden, Japanese, desert. You get the same place redesigned, keeping the house, walls and layout, or a new garden from your description.

ChatGPT lists your recent images, tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The new look opens in the chat and stays in your library next to the original.

For backyards, front yards, patios, rooftop terraces and balconies.

Limitations: it starts from images in your MegaScenes library; pictures attached in the chat are not passed to the plugin. The result is a visual idea, not a construction drawing or a list of plants to buy. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Redesign a garden from a photo in your library
Design an outdoor space from a description
Return the new look in the chat
defaultPrompt: Redesign my latest MegaScenes garden photo in Mediterranean style
Design a small Japanese style backyard with a stone path
Turn my last patio photo into a modern outdoor lounge

positive.prompt: Which garden photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Design a small Mediterranean backyard with olive trees. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one design with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can redesign a garden here?
positive.expected_behavior: The landscape design models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Design a small Mediterranean backyard with olive trees and a gravel path. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my garden design on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my garden design to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
